This is a wafer stage for lithography exposure equipment, which falls under heading 8486. Subheading 8486.20 covers machines and apparatus for the manufacture of semiconductor devices or integrated circuits. Heading 8486.90 covers parts and accessories, so the question is whether the wafer stage is a part or a complete machine.

A wafer stage is a major subassembly of a stepper or scanner. It is described as "a machine or apparatus that positions a silicon wafer," which suggests it could be treated as a machine in its own right. Still, it is most likely a part of the exposure tool, which would put it in 8486.90.0000, and the statistical suffix there is 8486.90.0000.

The alternative is 8486.20.00 with a 10-digit suffix. 8486.20.0000 is the only 10-digit code there, and it is for machines and apparatus for the manufacture of semiconductor devices. The description says it is a "machine or apparatus" that positions the wafer during metrology and exposure, which may point toward that code. Wafer stages are, however, generally classified as parts of lithography machines. Heading 8486 has its own parts provision, and 8486.90 is the applicable one.

I'm choosing 8486.90.0000, since the wafer stage is a subassembly of the exposure tool.
